responsibility: Low-level character and integer console I/O support imported by Ada code. It wraps getchar/putchar/fputc/scanf/fprintf and related routines, with target-specific adjustments for systems such as RTX, VMS, and VxWorks, and also supplies a VxWorks mktemp binding. This file is about primitive terminal-style I/O operations, distinct from the stream helpers in cstreams.c.
